qualification: Pre-fix trun offset resolution matched on (flags & 0x00_0001 != 0, list.last()), conflating the global track sample list with the current traf's data cursor. Valid empty-leading-run-then-contiguous.mp4 failed with 'sample chunk outside mdat' because list.last() was None after an empty trun with data_offset, while malformed second-traf-missing-data-offset.mp4 and empty-reset-run-outside-mdat.mp4 silently indexed and played by inheriting list.last() from earlier samples. All 4 forced acceptance tests failed pre-fix.

Tracking a per-traf cursor initialized to base and updated after every trun (including empty runs) admits empty-leading-run-then-contiguous.mp4 and refuses both cross-traf and empty-reset outside-mdat cases as Error::Invalid ('sample chunk outside mdat').

All 4 healthy controls (regular MP4, three contiguous runs in one traf, empty leading run setting the cursor for a second contiguous run, and two explicit-offset runs across two mdat boxes) retain exact coded packets, sync flags, 50 Hz clocks, sample/packet budgets, analytic 16x16 VP9 planes/RGB (128/130), 32 total public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF.
4 focused tests, 70 related MP4/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 17 MP4 unit tests, 33 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture generator unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.8.2 defines trun data continuity strictly within the enclosing track fragment (traf). All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/fMP4 files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One per-traf trun data-cursor continuity/reset fix (FVID-0182). No extra IDs for empty-run/cross-traf variants, controls, or fixture generator.
